adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb, the job does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` inside `rss.items.each`. If `i.content` is nil for any parsed item, this will raise `NoMethodError` on `nil.scrub` and abort the whole poll. The diff pins `simple-rss (1.3.1)` in the lockfile, but the diff itself doesn’t prove which item fields SimpleRSS populates for RSS vs Atom; it does show the code is not nil-safe while the setting claims “RSS/ATOM”.
